name: Gyro
description: It outputs stabilised values that can be sent to rotors and engines to make them much easier to control. An on/off input allows you to activate and deactivate the internal auto-hover circuit. When auto-hover is enabled, the gyroscope will attempt to keep your helicopter steady.
shortDescription: The gyroscope takes 4 standard value signals representing the desired yaw, pitch, roll and vertical motion of a helicopter.

logicNodes.label: Auto-hover
logicNodes.description: Enables the gyroscope's auto-hover circuit when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Roll
logicNodes.description: Accepts a standard value between -1 and 1 representing the desired roll speed.

logicNodes.label: Pitch
logicNodes.description: Accepts a standard value between -1 and 1 representing the desired pitch speed.

logicNodes.label: Yaw
logicNodes.description: Accepts a standard value between -1 and 1 representing the desired yaw speed.

logicNodes.label: Up/Down
logicNodes.description: Accepts a standard value between -1 and 1 representing the desired vertical speed.

logicNodes.label: Stabilised Roll
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1 representing a stabilised roll speed.

logicNodes.label: Stabilised Pitch
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1 representing a stabilised pitch speed.

logicNodes.label: Stabilised Yaw
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between -1 and 1 representing a stabilised yaw speed.

logicNodes.label: Stabilised Up/Down
logicNodes.description: Outputs a standard value between 0 and 1 representing a stabilised upward thrust.
